|lore=“Sir, we just lost the main rear deflector shield. One more direct hit on the back quarter and we’re done for!”
|game_text=Deploy on table. Your capital starship weapon destiny draws are +1. During your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to deploy a starship weapon (for free) on your capital starship from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If a starship was just hit, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to make that starship forfeit = 0.

|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Precision Targeting (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Precision Targeting (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The original slip and the [[:File:Dagobah-D-precisiontargeting-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher base card]] have no title dot. The remastered slip prints a dot. The period rule ordinarily retains the restriction of the underlying card. The later single weapon pull names your deploy phase, where the general deployment and One Rule rules govern the action. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 Period One Rule]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=44 Period deployment timing]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=95 Inherited restriction on virtual cards].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 45.
